title: CICS interview
transcript: Okay, you've been woken up, you're analyzing your logs of the various CICS systems that are running on your LPAR. What's the first thing you do? First, I check the health of the region itself. Is it up? Is it taking transactions? Are there any abends in the log? Then I look at whether it's one region or all of them on the LPAR. That splits a local problem from something systemic like a coupling facility or a shared database.
